title: Uncovering the gene regulatory network of type 2 diabetes through multi-omic data integration.
authors: Liu, Jiachen; Liu, Shenghua; Yu, Zhaomei; Qiu, Xiaorui; Jiang, Rundong; Li, Weizheng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学整合分析T2D基因调控网络，虽涉及转录因子结合特异性预测，但核心是疾病标志物与药物筛选，蛋白-DNA互作建模非重点，方法以组学统计和分子对接为主，与课题关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) onset is a complex, organized biological process with multilevel regulation, and its physiopathological mechanisms are yet to be elucidated. This study aims to find out the key drivers and pathways involved in the pathogenesis of T2D through multi-omics analysis. METHODS: The datasets used in the experiments comprise three groups: (1) genomic (2) transcriptomic, and (3) epigenomic categories. Then, a series of bioinformatics technologies including Marker set enrichment analysis (MSEA), weighted key driver analysis (wKDA) was performed to identify key drivers. The hub genes were further verified by the Receiver Operator Characteristic (ROC) Curve analysis, proteomic analysis, and Real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). The multi-omics network was applied to the Pharmomics pipeline in Mergeomics to identify drug candidates for T2D treatment. Then, we used the drug-gene interaction network to conduct network pharmacological analysis. Besides, molecular docking was performed using AutoDock/Vina, a computational docking program. RESULTS: Module-gene interaction network was constructed using MSEA, which revealed a significant enrichment of immune-related activities and glucose metabolism. Top 10 key drivers (PSMB9, COL1A1, COL4A1, HLA-DQB1, COL3A1, IRF7, COL5A1, CD74, HLA-DQA1, and HLA-DRB1) were selected by wKDA analysis. Among these, COL5A1, IRF7, CD74, and HLA-DRB1 were verified to have the capability to diagnose T2D, and expression levels of PSMB9 and CD74 had significantly higher in T2D patients. We further predict the co-expression network and transcription factor (TF) binding specificity of the key driver. Besides, based on module interaction networks and key driver networks, 17 compounds are considered to possess T2D-control potential, such as sunitinib. CONCLUSIONS: We identified signature genes, biomolecular processes, and pathways using multi-omics networks. Moreover, our computational network analysis revealed potential novel strategies for pharmacologic interventions of T2D.
abstract_zh: 背景：2型糖尿病（T2D）的发病是一个复杂、有组织的生物过程，涉及多层次调控，其病理生理机制尚未阐明。本研究旨在通过多组学分析，找出T2D发病机制中的关键驱动因子和通路。方法：实验中使用的数据集包括三组：（1）基因组，（2）转录组，（3）表观基因组。随后，采用一系列生物信息学技术，包括标记集富集分析（MSEA）和加权关键驱动因子分析（wKDA），以识别关键驱动因子。枢纽基因进一步通过受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析、蛋白质组学分析和实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）进行验证。多组学网络应用于Mergeomics中的Pharmomics流程，以识别T2D治疗的候选药物。然后，我们利用药物-基因相互作用网络进行网络药理学分析。此外，使用AutoDock/Vina（一种计算对接程序）进行分子对接。结果：利用MSEA构建了模块-基因相互作用网络，揭示了免疫相关活动和葡萄糖代谢的显著富集。通过wKDA分析选出了前10个关键驱动因子（PSMB9、COL1A1、COL4A1、HLA-DQB1、COL3A1、IRF7、COL5A1、CD74、HLA-DQA1和HLA-DRB1）。其中，COL5A1、IRF7、CD74和HLA-DRB1被验证具有诊断T2D的能力，且PSMB9和CD74在T2D患者中的表达水平显著升高。我们进一步预测了关键驱动因子的共表达网络和转录因子（TF）结合特异性。此外，基于模块相互作用网络和关键驱动因子网络，17种化合物被认为具有控制T2D的潜力，如舒尼替尼。结论：我们利用多组学网络识别了特征基因、生物分子过程和通路。此外，我们的计算网络分析揭示了T2D药物干预的潜在新策略。
